title: DPA liability-tiering & indemnity negotiation assist: telemetry-driven clause suggestion flow
creator: Marisol Vega
description:
Problem: Enterprise negotiations for MSA/DPA clauses (liability caps, indemnity language, escrow/insurance asks) are a major friction point for closing dedicated and private contracts. Legal review time and counterparty redlines spike sales cycle length and create unpredictable pricing concessions.

Goal: Deliver an MVP feature in the Enterprise Contracts workflow that: (1) analyzes historical redline telemetry and pricing outcomes to recommend a liability tier and indemnity posture for new deals, and (2) surfaces suggested clause edits for common DPA/indemnity concessions. The feature should be advisory (no auto-apply), attach clear pricing impact guidance, and include audit logging for legal ops.

Scope (MVP):
- Backend service that ingests past closed ticket telemetry (redline tags, negotiated liability caps, final contract tier, price concession %, time-to-sign) and trains a simple ruleset + scoring model for liability tier suggestion.
- UI in Contract Review panel: a "Suggested Liability & Indemnity" card with: suggested tier (e.g., Standard / Elevated / Enterprise), rationale bullets pulled from comparable past deals, and an estimated pricing impact band (low/medium/high).
- Clause suggestion snippets for 3 common indemnity variants and 2 common DPA liability cap edits that legal can copy into redlines.
- Links to source artifacts (past PRs, signed contracts) that informed the suggestion.
- Telemetry counters to show suggestion acceptance rate, mean delta in days-to-sign when suggestion followed, and pricing concession delta.

Out of scope for MVP: auto-apply suggestions, automated negotiation messaging to counterparty, full ML model lifecycle (we'll use a lightweight rules+score approach).

Trade-offs and decisions so far:
- Accuracy vs explainability: we prioritized transparent rule-based scoring (e.g., customer ARR bucket, industry, data classification, previous concessions) for faster legal adoption rather than an opaque ML model.
- Safety: suggestions will never change contract text automatically; a human-in-loop guard ensures legal approval.
- Privacy: we will only surface anonymized examples and never expose customer-identifying PII in the UI.

Success metrics (OKRs):
- Reduce median legal review time on DPA redlines by 20% for pilot accounts within 3 months.
- Achieve >= 40% suggestion acceptance rate in pilot.
- Track pricing concession delta when suggestion is used vs not used (target: no >5% revenue hit on average).
acceptance_criteria: Backend ingest pipeline runs end-to-end on historical closed-deals data and produces a scoring table for liability tiers
Contract Review UI shows Suggested Liability & Indemnity card for eligible deals (private/dedicated/EUA customers)
Card displays rationale, example anonymized precedents (links), and an estimated pricing impact band
Legal reviewer can copy suggested clause snippets into the redline editor with one click
All suggestions and reviewer actions are recorded in audit logs (user, timestamp, suggestion id, accepted/rejected)
Telemetry events emitted: suggestion_shown, suggestion_accepted, suggestion_rejected, time_to_sign_post_suggestion
Pilot run with <team: Solutions Sales 2> on a minimum of 25 deals and initial metrics captured
